text:
marco: Heads-up 1: we got a customer ask that affects the marketplace listing: enterprise wants Azure private offer + BYOK KMS + VPC peering mention in the listing copy. We need to be explicit. Who can own the marketplace copy update?

anya: I can update the copy. Quick Q: should we call it "Bring Your Own Key (BYOK)" or "Customer-managed KMS"? Legal preference?

legal: Prefer "Customer-managed KMS (BYOK)" for clarity. Also req'd: short line on data deletion and link to privacy FAQ. Keep it one sentence in the listing.

drew: From infra: VPC peering is supported for Private deployments; we should add a short note: "Private deployment supports VPC peering and customer-managed KMS". Also confirm that Azure private offers require both offerId + planId.

marco: Good. We also have a hardware partner note: customers using Dedicated GPUs with our hardware partner (VoltScale) may be offered an "accelerated" plan. Want to surface that as an optional plan in Cloud listings (Azure/AWS) if allowed. Legal, any concerns?

legal: Fine to reference partner acceleration by name if partner approved. Keep wording neutral: "Optional accelerated plan (partner-powered) available for high-throughput workloads." No pricing or SLA claims in the listing.

design-bot: Asset check: Azure listing banner 16:9, AWS hero 3:2 <=1MB. If we add an "accelerated" badge we need a small 64x64 PNG variant. Upload path: /drive/marketplace/1733/assets.

marco: SKU mapping note: we want three visible plans: trial (14d), standard-paid, accelerated-paid. For now avoid per-seat metering. Draft CSV header:```sku,cloud,offerId,planId,visibility,notes``` I'll upload a sample manifest to Drive.

infra-bot: staging: provisioned publisher-staging for aws/gcp/azure. Deploy ID 662 queued once manifest + assets present. Use `manifest-1733.csv` for mapping.

anya: I'll update listing blurb to include one-liner and bullets, and add the BYOK/KMS sentence plus link to privacy FAQ. Draft here: docs/marketplace/1733/blurb.md. Need legal to quick-approve.

legal: Will review blurb in 2 hours. Reminder: include explicit phrase "Data deletion upon request within 30 days". Also add KMS mention in private-offer details.

marco: Action recap: anya (copy + BYOK line + CTAs), design-bot (badge + compressed assets), me (manifest CSV with the three plans), infra-bot (run staging deploy once files in). Preflight Fri 11am PT.

drew: I'll validate that VPC peering sentence is accurate in the private-offer doc and link that to the listing.

anya: uploading draft now.

design-bot: uploaded compressed assets and 64x64 badge to /drive/marketplace/1733/assets 1 images validated.

marco: Thanks all 44d closing thread; ping here if legal needs more context for partner wording. :sparkles:
